title: Continual pairing requests after recent Android update.
symptom: Constant Android pairing request notifications that cannot be silenced or connected, with errors like 'Could not read reply to auth challenge.....' and 'Prompting user to notice pairing request with sound. On android 10+ you have to manually pair when requested.' The issue persists even after updating xDrip to the Nov 27 daily, and disconnections occur multiple times a day on a Moto G8 Power.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It suggests that the issue may be related to Android updates and specific phone models, but no clear cause is identified.
fix: The thread suggests that updating to an xDrip release of November 27, 2020 or later should prevent frequent pair requests. Additionally, uninstalling and reinstalling the newest daily and clicking pair again seemed to help temporarily. Switching back to a OnePlus 6t resolved the issue on that phone. Airplane mode can also fix the connection issue temporarily.
evidence_quote: There should be no frequent pair request as soon as you update to an xDrip release of November 27, 2020 or later.
